question: Which entities situated in sacred supports are addressed at the end of the rite?
premises: The action occurs at the end of that rite
Entities are situated in images, image-lords, liṅga, and pedestal
inference: At the end, those situated in the image, image-lords, liṅga, pedestal, and so forth are addressed.
plain_english: At the end of that, those situated in the image, the lords of the images, the liṅga, the pedestal, and so forth—
